relationships.subject: Lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Among them, the erythrocyte sedimentation rate, CRP level, CGRP level, and interleukin-6 level of group B were significantly lower than those of group A.

relationships.subject: Lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: The incidence of postherpetic neuralgia (PHN) in group B patients (6.25%) was also lower than that in group A patients (25%).

key_findings: Pulsed radiofrequency plus intravenous lidocaine reduced VAS, anxiety, depression, sleep scores, analgesic use and serum CGRP/IL-6/CRP more than PRF alone in subacute herpes zoster neuralgia.
PHN incidence was 6.25% with lidocaine vs 25% with PRF alone.
